name: Поля й відкритий напад
description:
Let's return to attacking a mating square. In addition to the double attack, you can also use the discovered attack to attack both a piece and mating square at the same time.


What do you have to do?

Use a discovered attack to gain material. You can do this in two ways:

- Use the piece in front of a battery to attack a piece and attack a mating square with the piece behind.

- Attack a mating square with the piece in front and uncover an attack on an enemy piece with the piece behind.

You are already familiar with this, but it never hurts to refresh your memory. Fast-forward to the example!

examples.text: The white queen and bishop are eying a mating square on h7. An issue is that the white rook is in the way. If white removes the rook, black can defend against mate with ...g7-g6. So the key is to place the rook intelligently. The queen on d6 is unprotected. With 1.Re6! White kills two birds with one stone. Both the queen and mate square h7 are attacked. 1...g6 now costs a queen, and 1...Qxe6 2.Qh7 is mate!
